name: get_status
description: Get the current state of every agent: state, task, one-line summary, and stuck reason if any. Call this before answering any question about what the team is doing.

name: show_grid
description: Switch the video to the grid view showing all agents side by side. Voice calls only; on web chat this does nothing.

name: focus_agent
description: Switch the video to a full-screen view of one agent ("show me agent 2"). Voice calls only; on web chat this does nothing.

name: send_task
description: Give an agent an instruction: a new task or a follow-up to what it is already doing ("tell agent 1 to use the v2 endpoint"). Use this to unblock a stuck agent.

instruction.description: What the agent should do, in plain words.

name: pause_agent
description: Pause an agent so it stops working until resumed.

name: stop_all
description: Emergency kill switch: stop every agent immediately ("stop everything"). Use only when the user clearly asks to stop all work.

name: explain_agent
description: Fetch an agent's recent activity log so you can say what it is doing. Summarize the result in one short sentence; never read the log aloud.

name: create_task
description: Create a task on the board. With an agent number it starts on that agent immediately; without one it waits in the queue.

agent.description: Optional agent number to assign the task to.

name: decide_approval
description: Approve or deny a pending approval, such as an agent asking to push. Only call this after the user has clearly said yes or no.

id.description: Approval id, as listed in the pending approvals.

name: search_history
description: Full-text search over past calls and chats. Use when the user asks about something discussed earlier that is not in the recap.
